title: Best Cursor MCP Tools in 2026: 8 Extensions That Make Cursor 10x More Powerful
summary: The 8 best MCP tools to add to Cursor in 2026 — ranked by usefulness, with setup instructions and real-world use cases. Blink, GitHub, Linear, Postgres, Brave Search, and more.
body_markdown: It depends on the tool and how you configure it. Postgres MCP should always use a read-only database user. GitHub MCP should use a token with the minimum required permissions. Blink MCP is designed for infrastructure provisioning and is safe by default. Never give an MCP tool write access to production data unless you fully understand what it can do.
